---
title: "Getting Started"
---

For am example of how to load a pedigree, see @lst-load-pedigree.

```{python}
#| label: lst-load-pedigree
#| fig-cap: "Loading a pedigree into PyPedal"

from PyPedal import pyp_newclasses
options = {
    'renumber': 0,
    'pedfile': '../test_files/mrode.ped',
    'pedformat': 'asd',
    'pedname': 'Mrode Pedigree Table 2.1',
    'pedigree_is_renumbered': 1,
    'messages': 'quiet',
}
result = pyp_newclasses.load_pedigree(options)
result.metadata.printme()
```
